request.query: Comparison of nonnegative numbers by squaring inequalities

items.name: sq_lt_sq₀
items.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M₀] [PosMulStrictMono M₀] {a b : M₀} [MulPosMono M₀],
  0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → (a ^ 2 < b ^ 2 ↔ a < b)

items.name: nonneg_le_nonneg_of_sq_le_sq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [MulPosMono R] {a b : R},
  0 ≤ b → a * a ≤ b * b → a ≤ b

items.name: mul_self_le_mul_self_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [MulPosMono R] {a b : R},
  0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → (a ≤ b ↔ a * a ≤ b * b)

items.name: mul_self_le_mul_self
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MulZeroClass α] {a b : α} [inst_1 : Preorder α] [PosMulMono α] [MulPosMono α],
  0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → a * a ≤ b * b

items.name: mul_self_lt_mul_self_iff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [MulPosMono R] {a b : R},
  0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → (a < b ↔ a * a < b * b)
